#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int P, K;
    cin >> P >> K;
    const long long MOD = 1000000007;

    vector<int> k(P);
    for (int x = 0; x < P; ++x) {
        k[x] = (K * x) % P;
    }

    if (K == 0) {
        long long ans = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < P - 1; ++i) {
            ans = (ans * P) % MOD;
        }
        cout << ans << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
    if (K == 1) {
        long long ans = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < P; ++i) {
            ans = (ans * P) % MOD;
        }
        cout << ans << "\n";
        return 0;
    }

    vector<int> f(P, 0);
    vector<int> c(P, 0);
    long long result = 1;

    for (int i = 0; i < P; ++i) {
        if (f[i]) continue;
        int count = 1;
        int u = i;
        f[u] = 1;
        while (!f[k[u]]) {
            u = k[u];
            f[u] = 1;
            ++count;
        }
        c[count]++;
    }

    for (int i = 2; i < P; ++i) {
        if (c[i]) {
            long long total = (long long)i * c[i] + 1;
            long long power = c[i];
            long long base = total % MOD;
            long long res_pow = 1;
            long long base_pow = base;
            long long exp = power;
            while (exp > 0) {
                if (exp & 1) {
                    res_pow = (res_pow * base_pow) % MOD;
                }
                base_pow = (base_pow * base_pow) % MOD;
                exp >>= 1;
            }
            result = (result * res_pow) % MOD;
        }
    }

    cout << result << "\n";

    return 0;
}
